workstream: Wave 3C-2 — Makati parks and civic-space completeness
reason: The original 3C-2 added only three CBD parks. Official Makati sources publish substantially broader park inventories, so that batch was preliminary and did not satisfy the completeness goal.

primary.description: City inventory listing 16 public parks with locations; source attributed to DEPW in the facilities table.
publishedPublicParks: Guadalupe Viejo Cloverleaf (Kennely Ann Binay Park)
Guadalupe Nuevo Cloverleaf (Kennely Ann Binay Park)

secondary.description: City states 18 parks: 12 government-maintained and 6 private, and maps named park/open-space locations.

secondary.source: Department of Environmental Services Citizen's Charter
secondary.description: Current operational evidence for Parks and Green Division offices at Magallanes Interchange Park and Kennely Ann Lacia Binay Park, Guadalupe Nuevo.

secondary.source: Philippine Statistics Authority PSGC — City of Makati
secondary.description: Current Makati geography: 23 barangays; former EMBO barangays are not part of present-day Makati.

preliminaryWorkAlreadyDone.note: These remain valid Civic Map assets but are private/public-access CBD green spaces, not a substitute for the City Government's public-park inventory.

revisedSubsteps.title: Reconcile official Makati park inventories
revisedSubsteps.goal: Build one canonical crosswalk across the city's 12-, 16- and 18-park lists before touching Civic Map data.
tasks: Extract every named park/open-space entry from the official Makati inventories.
Normalize obvious spelling and naming variants without assuming two differently named sites are identical.
Record which source/vintage each name appears in.
Separate government-maintained/public parks from private/public-access parks where the source does so.
revisedSubsteps.stopWhen: Every official park name from the reviewed city inventories is represented once in a source crosswalk.

revisedSubsteps.title: Reconcile parks to current Makati geography
revisedSubsteps.goal: Translate historical city inventories into the current 23-barangay Makati boundary.
tasks: Mark parks in West Rembo, Cembo, East Rembo and any other now-outside-Makati location as historical/former-Makati rather than current Makati assets.
Keep them in the audit for provenance, but exclude them from current-Makati completeness counts.
Resolve present-day barangay assignment only where supported; do not infer uncertain boundary cases.
revisedSubsteps.stopWhen: Every historical inventory entry has current-Makati / former-Makati / boundary-uncertain status.

revisedSubsteps.title: Verify current public parks
revisedSubsteps.goal: Verify the current existence, current name and mappable location of every current-Makati public-park candidate.
startingCandidates: Guadalupe Viejo Cloverleaf / Kennely Ann Binay Park
Guadalupe Nuevo Cloverleaf / Kennely Ann Binay Park
tasks: Prefer current Makati government/DES/DEPW/official barangay evidence.
Use current map geometry only for point/location verification, not as authority for ownership or operating status.
Flag renamed, absorbed, redeveloped or unverifiable sites rather than silently dropping them.
Capture address, barangay, authority, source and coordinate provenance.
revisedSubsteps.splitRule: If verification is large, execute in bounded batches such as 3C-2c1, 3C-2c2, etc.

revisedSubsteps.title: Implement verified current public parks
revisedSubsteps.goal: Make the Civic Map complete for verified government-maintained/public parks within present-day Makati.
tasks: Add every verified current public park not already mapped.
Retain park-specific rating/reporting criteria.
Display official source and coordinate provenance.
Add integrity guards against losing verified public-park coverage.
revisedSubsteps.stopWhen: Every verified current public park from the reconciled official inventory is represented, or explicitly marked unresolved with a reason.

revisedSubsteps.title: Reconcile private and public-access green spaces
revisedSubsteps.goal: Treat private/public-access parks as a separate layer instead of mixing them into the public-park completeness count.
tasks: Reconcile Ayala Triangle Gardens, Washington SyCip Park, Legazpi Active Park and other officially listed private/public-access parks/open spaces.
Verify current access/management and present-day Makati location.
Define a simple ownership/access metadata field if needed so public vs private/public-access is visible in data without sermon copy.
revisedSubsteps.stopWhen: The private/public-access park list is normalized and classified.

revisedSubsteps.title: Implement private/public-access park layer
revisedSubsteps.goal: Add verified private/public-access parks without confusing them with government-maintained public parks.
tasks: Add missing verified private/public-access park assets.
Apply ownership/access metadata consistently.
Keep the three already-added CBD parks and reclassify them in metadata if necessary.

revisedSubsteps.title: Close park completeness
revisedSubsteps.goal: Audit the final park layer against all official Makati inventories and current Makati geography.
tasks: Report counts for current public parks, private/public-access parks, historical/former-Makati parks and unresolved entries.
Update Civic Map/page audit gaps.
Require all verified current park IDs in the Civic Map integrity check.
Do not claim completeness for any unresolved site.
revisedSubsteps.stopWhen: Every official-inventory park has a transparent final disposition.

countingRule.publicParkCompleteness: Only verified government-maintained/public parks inside current Makati count toward public-park completeness.
countingRule.privatePublicAccess: Tracked separately and never used to inflate the public-park count.
countingRule.formerMakati: Preserved as historical inventory records but excluded from current Makati coverage.
countingRule.unresolved: Remain visible in the audit and prevent a false completeness claim.

immediateNext.title: Reconcile parks to current Makati geography
immediateNext.maximumScope: Geography/disposition classification only. No Civic Map additions.
